candidates.name: centraldedados/alojamento_local
candidates.what_it_holds: Python scraper (fetch_rnal.py, fetch_rnal_setup.py, using Splinter/RoboBrowser) for Portugal's Registo Nacional do Alojamento Local (RNAL), the national short-term-rental licence registry. Covers all 308 Portuguese municipalities; supports selective scraping by municipality range. Includes a municipal reference table (Concelhos_CAOP2018.csv, CAOP 2018 codes). No data is pre-committed to the repo -- running the script produces one CSV per municipality (Down_<DICO>_<NOME>.csv), split into time-period parts for large cities (Lisbon, Porto). 12 commits, 3 stars, 6 watchers; license and last-commit date not visible from the README fetch.
candidates.why_useful: Directly targets numbered gap 12 (STR registration/city registration datasets -- explicitly names Lisbon RNAL). RNAL is the closest thing to a full-market STR supply census for Portugal (active listing counts, addresses/parishes, licence dates by municipality), which is not otherwise in our municipal-registry holdings (Austin, Barcelona HUTB, Maui, NYC OSE, California TOT). A working, already-built scraper against a live government portal (not airbnb.com) means point-in-time supply counts for a full EU country could be pulled without violating the airbnb.com scraping restriction -- worth a human call on whether to actually run it.
candidates.time_coverage: Current registry snapshot at time of run (not historical/vintage; would need repeated runs for a time series)
candidates.size_hint: Method only, no committed data; output size scales with RNAL registry (Lisbon/Porto require multi-part downloads implying tens of thousands of listings nationally)
candidates.last_activity: not visible from README fetch (12 commits total)

candidates.name: Inquilinato-Cadiz/mapa
candidates.what_it_holds: Astro/Leaflet static site with committed data pulled from OpenRTA, the Andalusian regional tourism registry (Registro de Turismo de Andalucía), CC BY 4.0, refreshed monthly via GitHub Actions. Files: public/data/municipios/<slug>.geojson (per-municipality tourist-dwelling points, filtered to 'vivienda de uso turístico' and 'apartamento turístico' categories, contact info stripped, reprojected EPSG:25830->WGS84), src/data/municipios.json (index), src/data/stats.json (aggregate stats), plus a cadastral large-owner layer (fincas-cadiz.geojson / fincas.json). Covers all 45 municipalities of Cádiz province.
candidates.why_useful: A live, automatically-refreshed, geolocated STR-registry dataset for a full Spanish province beyond Barcelona (which we already hold via HUTB) -- fills gap 12 with finer city coverage in Spain and demonstrates OpenRTA as a pullable regional source that could be extended to other Andalusian provinces (Málaga/Costa del Sol, Granada, Seville) for a party of the EMEA STR-supply picture.
candidates.time_coverage: Monthly automated snapshots going forward from repo creation; not clear how far back history is retained in git history of the geojson files
candidates.size_hint: 45 municipality geojson files + 2 aggregate JSON files, per-listing point data with property type
candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 for the underlying OpenRTA data; repo code license not confirmed
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: Adjacent to our existing Barcelona HUTB holding but a different Spanish region/registry (Andalusia OpenRTA vs Barcelona HUTB) -- not a duplicate

candidates.name: diagmatrix/tourism-watcher
candidates.what_it_holds: Python monitoring project for Granada, Spain that (a) scrapes Airbnb search results directly for 'Granada, España' with flexible dates, and (b) has an in-progress secondary track pulling public tourist-housing permit data. Data collection in a `data/` folder starting 2024-10-15; 18 commits; GPL-3.0. Per the README the permit/registry side (the useful, non-Airbnb half for our purposes) is still described as under development, not yet delivering committed registry data.
candidates.why_useful: The permit-registry half, if completed, would be another Spanish-city STR licence dataset (gap 12); flagged mainly because the primary/working half of the tool scrapes Airbnb search pages directly, which is out of scope under our sanctioned-sources rule -- catalogue only, do not run.
candidates.size_hint: Small, early-stage; data folder exists but registry portion incomplete
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: Partially overlaps existing Inside Airbnb Barcelona coverage in spirit but different city (Granada) and different source (permit registry, once built)

notes: This theme is thin on GitHub relative to Inside Airbnb-style repos: national/city STR registries in Europe (Portugal RNAL, Italy CIN, France's API Meublés / registre-des-autorisations-de-changement-dusage, Amsterdam, Berlin Zweckentfremdungsverbot, Vienna Meldepflicht) overwhelmingly live on official open-data portals (opendata.paris.fr, dati.gov.it, offenedaten.de, data.gouv.fr, OpenRTA Andalusia) rather than as GitHub mirrors or scrapers -- most gh/WebSearch queries for CIN, French meublés, Berlin, Vienna and Amsterdam-specific terms returned zero GitHub hits despite the underlying government datasets clearly existing (confirmed e.g. Paris opendata 'registre-des-autorisations-de-changement-dusage-pour-les-meubles' and Italy's CIN system are real, current open-data assets as of Sep 2026, just not GitHub-hosted or not yet mirrored/scraped by anyone with a public repo). Barcelona HUTB (already held) and the Andalusia/Cádiz OpenRTA project above are the only committed-data hits found. The Portugal RNAL scraper (centraldedados/alojamento_local) is the strongest find: a mature, multi-municipality scraper against a live Portuguese government portal, not against airbnb.com, so it sits inside the sanctioned-sources boundary for a human to decide whether to run. Recommend a follow-up scout specifically target (a) France's API Meublés / data.gouv.fr registre-des-autorisations mirrors on GitHub, (b) Italy's regional CIN portals (Toscana, Lazio, Lombardia each publish separately) for any GitHub client/scraper, and (c) Dutch/German/Austrian municipal open-data portals (data.overheid.nl, offenedaten.de) via CKAN/Socrata discovery tooling (gap 17) rather than repo-name search, since none of those cities' registries appear to have GitHub-native scrapers yet. Also note: mid-run the shared WebSearch budget for this Claude Code session was exhausted (200/200) partway through, cutting off three planned queries (Paris opendata GitHub mirror, generic EU STR-regulation-tracker repos, Andalusia registry scraper repos) -- those three queries returned no results before the cutoff and should be re-tried by a scout with a fresh search budget.
